_comment: Aligned triplets for the AI Research Knowledge Base (Use Case A). Each entry: one paper (arXiv PDF), one YouTube talk, one public slide-deck PDF on the same topic. URLs verified 2026-07-27. video_alignment/deck_alignment: how tightly the artifact covers THIS paper.

triplets.paper_title: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al. 2017)
triplets.deck_note: UIUC ECE537 Lecture 23 - Attention is All You Need

triplets.video_note: Stanford CS224N guest lecture by Jacob Devlin (lead author)

triplets.deck_note: Official ICML 2021 author slides for the CLIP paper

triplets.video_note: Jason Wei (lead author) Stanford talk on emergence/reasoning
triplets.video_alignment: high (author; CoT central but talk is broader)
triplets.deck_note: Harvard CS282BR seminar deck on the CoT paper

triplets.paper_title: GPT-3: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (Brown et al. 2020)
triplets.deck_note: Ohio State CSE5539 seminar deck on GPT-3

known_gaps: DPR (arXiv 2004.04906): no confirmed author video + paper-specific deck found
DPO (arXiv 2305.18290): author talk only on SlidesLive (pipeline needs YouTube); no confirmed deck
Caption availability not programmatically verified for any video - spot-check before relying on the transcript branch
.edu / GitHub Pages deck URLs can rotate across course terms - download local copies before the big backfill (do NOT commit the PDFs)
backfill_note: These 8 triplets are the demo + recall corpus. The scale/decoupling benchmark additionally backfills 50-200 arXiv PDFs (any recent cs.CL/cs.LG listing) - papers only, no videos needed.
